processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Minimal Processing has been conducted to establish basic intellectual and physical control of the material and assess immediate preservation and conservation needs. Material remains as received, in original folders and storage boxes.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains trip files, conference files, subject files, reports and speeches.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Arranged in 3 series by file type.
Series I. Trip and Conference Files, 1972-1980

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Michael Teitelbaum is a demographer, former foundation executive, and educator. He worked at the Ford Foundation during two different stints of time as a Program Officer in the Population Program.

In between his two stints at the Ford Foundation, Teitelbaum worked as a lecturer on demography at Oxford University. He joined the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation in 1983 as a Program Director after his second time at the Ford Foundation and later became Vice President of the organization. Shortly before leaving the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Teitelbaum became a Wertheim Fellow at Harvard Law School in 2010.
Teitelbaum earned a B.A. in sociology and biology from Reed College and a D.Phil in demography from Oxford University.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Ford Foundation has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them.

The Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection. Permission to publish extensive excerpts, or material in its entirety, will be referred to the Ford Foundation.
